# AstraLex shader LOD prerequisite R1

2026-10-09 · Worker `/root/astralex_shader_lod_candidate_r1`; parent owns all
active source, builds, client/reloads, GPU work, world/profile mutations and goal
checkpoints. **Stopped at the assigned working-original gate. No candidate,
full-work or cue archive was fabricated; no active-cost admission, rendering,
quality or performance result.** No worker-owned live process remains; CPU
released after this report. This is a bounded prerequisite handback, not project
completion or a global rejection of AstraLex optimization.

The pinned AstraLex 93.0 ASCII original SHA-256 is
`70b6d8127a6733f0a19bd1d351b92709d6ee7496967ff49c4793d2c28c7a6c58`.
Its unchanged bytes and ten relevant source/attribution members are frozen under
[staging](../../dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/astralex-shader-lod-candidate-r1/).
[Receipt](../../dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/astralex-shader-lod-candidate-r1/receipt.json)
records their exact hashes and hashes of historical evidence. Credits and
Changelog remain byte-identical. Private staging is not redistribution permission.

The original NeoForge 21.1.253 / Minecraft 1.21.1 / Iris
`1.8.12-snapshot+mc1.21.1-local` / Sodium 0.6.13 attempt selected Custom with
zero user option changes and the actual original at
[console line 77](../../dev/logs/dev-client/20261006-214218-on-4607c792/console.log:77).
Its native crash enters `glpLinkProgram` at

A later original-only, ShaderLOD-Off Fabric / Minecraft 26.3 / Iris 1.11.7 /

Both report Apple M3 Max / macOS 27.0 / OpenGL 4.1 Metal - 91.7. The
[26.3 final proof](../../dev/logs/astralex-263-original-r1/final-proof.json)
explicitly records no accepted original world frame, no native fullscreen/focus
stage and no quality reflection witness. The failed program and transformed IR
remain unknown. A working original and its complete effective option map are
absent from the inspected evidence; source defaults are not loaded-option proof.

The narrow source inspection identifies possible capture entry points, without
asserting active cost. `world0/deferred.fsh` includes `program/deferred.glsl`;
its `DoAmbientOcclusion` at line 135 has native AO_QUALITY 1/2 branches with
4/12 paired-depth iterations. The caller at line 300 requires `AO` and `z<1`,
and the helper immediately returns for `z<0.56`. `world0/composite.fsh` includes
`program/composite.glsl`; `getVolumetricRays` is called at line 245 under
Overworld LIGHT_SHAFT or End LIGHT_SHAFT_END. The helper in
`lib/atmospherics/volumetricLight.glsl` has ten maximum iterations, native depth
and distance exits, colored-shadow/noise/water terms, outside-map addition and
nonlinear postprocessing. Native AO and light-shaft source flags/quality settings
do not demonstrate loop execution or substantial cost. The earlier rough metric
candidate is not reopened: native `REFLECTION_ROUGH` remains source-default Off,
and that arithmetic may already be compiler-eliminated.

Parent's minimum admission is the
[100 s original-capture request](../../dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/astralex-shader-lod-candidate-r1/original-capture-request.json):
a concrete native-semantics-preserving changed linker/transform premise or an
independently demonstrated working original on the authorized Mac runtime,
followed by one settled original frame, exact archive/effective native options,
fresh complete deferred/composite transformed exports joined to the current
program, and actual native SSAO or VL work coverage through existing hooks.
Record runtime/artifact identities, sampler state when available, canonical
scene/camera/time/native resolution/focus and exact stop/release. The request is
unprepared and unlaunched. A version-number change alone is not a fixed premise;
unchanged known failures must not be retried. Native feature/preset/AA/history,
graph, scene or sampler reductions must not manufacture a baseline.

No transition or new distance threshold was implemented. Future distance inputs
must use blocks; native GetLinearDepth is normalized depth, SSAO offsets are UV
and projected footprint is pixels. Additive VL visibility is not opacity.
A future candidate must consume bridge version 2, enabled 1 and presets 0–2
before expensive work; missing bridge, Off, Quality 3, wrong bridge and unknown
preset retain native full work. Avoid unverified implicit derivatives under new
divergence, preserve all native AA/history/options/settings/graph and distant
lighting/shadow/color cues. Closed count/rate/threshold/filter/scene/preset trials
remain closed. This contract is recorded, not implemented or runtime-verified.

Checks actually run: Python SHA-256 pin equality, full ZIP CRC integrity,
ten extracted-member byte/hash checks, native entry/caller/loop/default marker
assertions, two historical original SIGSEGV/linker assertions and the failed
26.3 admission assertions. They passed; exact
[script](../../dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/astralex-shader-lod-candidate-r1/freeze_prerequisite.py)
and [log](../../dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/astralex-shader-lod-candidate-r1/static-checks.log)
are frozen. No GLSL parser, Java/build test, client launch, reload, cue, visual
comparison or timing was run. No source diff or fullwork/candidate/cue hash exists
because implementation stopped at the explicit gate.

After admission, parent can assign one distinct contribution/projected-footprint
candidate. Required cost evidence remains a short matched original → full-work
control → enabled → original-return comparison with classifier/branch/resolve
and driver overhead charged, native settings unchanged and cue excluded. Any GPU
performance claim requires measured affected-pass and total-frame GPU timings;
still/motion, distant cues, PBR and DH require separate validation. No gain is
claimed here.

# Independent review: AstraLex staged AO budget

Accepted as a bounded source candidate on the FINAL sealed stage. No concrete wrong-weight, prefix-truncation, asymmetric-pair or wrong-pass defect found. Actual driver, PBR, quality/equivalence, motion, executed count and performance acceptance remain unverified; the original Apple linker blocker remains. No tests/builds/clients/main edits were performed; only this report was written.

Reviewed actual ASCII original `dev/upstream/pack-expansion/AstraLex-93.0-original-ascii.zip`, staged recipe/helper/mirrors under `dev/logs/concept-transfer-r1/astralex-ao/stage/`, final assembled `source-adapter-r2.zip`, original/patched deferred members, patch and handback. Independent use of existing `build_supported_pack_adapters.read_archive/apply` reproduced all final generated source member bytes (excluding the two builder metadata/note additions). Reversing every patch in reverse order and removing additions recovered every original member byte exactly. Authentic deferred-member mutation and genuine added-helper collision each refused at pinned source identity. Shared helper bytes equal the maintained helper and its pinned hash; family staged/package mirrors agree. Worker helper-tamper refusal is retained in handback; reviewer did not mutate shared files to repeat it.

Final source digest is **`7a59f0be267d52c977371e9cf621e401a93030a7107f6b26410599e80ed4ae91`**, distinct from final ZIP SHA **`82e3100302ec1591576a3f26bb560bb6d70ae7ba10baf2fec3710eaea0dd822a`**. Final patch SHA is `4cd3ad79d5c2930bab52a66c1b1f4d9a604399ba656e6720300396b06002b1b6`. Earlier draft source13fe/ZIP40e4 is preserved but superseded: final adds explicit AO_FOVSCALE1..5 admission. Source digests are canonical shader identities, not ZIP container hashes.

Authentic world0 deferred.fsh defines DEFERRED/OVERWORLD/FRAGMENT and includes program/deferred.glsl; both caller and actual AO member plus settings are source-pinned. Native settings have AO_QUALITY2, AO_FOVSCALE4 and ADVANCED_MATERIALS defined. Native AO_QUALITY2 sets N12/scm0.6; quality1 sets N4/scm0.4. The owned branch applies only DEFERRED/FRAGMENT/OVERWORLD/AO_QUALITY2, declared AO_FOVSCALE1..5 and no DH/Voxy. Unsupported pass/quality/FOV and external contexts compile the original loop/mean. No advanced-material exclusion is imposed; the AO itself reads depth, but that observation is only a PBR-unclassified source hypothesis, not compatibility evidence.

Count selection budgets two-iteration groups: original6/minimum4, then doubles the returned group count. Existing unchanged ABI2 policy returns6 groups for Balanced (ceil5.25), preserving12 iterations, and5 for Performance/Aggr (ceil4.5), yielding10. Even counts preserve alternating y-sign population. Each iteration still evaluates native texCoord+offset and texCoord-offset depth samples, native angle/distance clamps and pair accumulation; native radius/scm/FOV/depth scale and AO post-mean remap/strength are preserved.

For reduction, virtual index is `i*N/M + dither` passed to original OffsetDist with native denominatorN. At i=M it reaches N+dither, retaining the native nominal outer radius and dither/N margin; samples are redistributed across the interval rather than selecting the firstM native indices. OffsetDist also changes angle with virtual index, so this is approximate spatial quadrature, not exact AO equality. Normalization uses1/M for reduced counts, followed by native nonlinear remap and strength. When count is unchanged, the native `OffsetDist(i+dither,samples)` expression and native1/N mean are used exactly, retaining original pair-body operations. Off, Quality, unknown bridge/preset and invalid minimum/count return native via unchanged uniform helper; no replacement policy or transport was introduced.

Existing guarded family include owns the same six Core uniforms, includes the unchanged refinement and uniform-budget helpers once, and retains existing water SSR controls. Native AA/settings and non-owned upstream members remain unchanged. There is no new derivative rescue: implicit depth texture reads remain in the native pair body; native-stage/Iris/driver compilation and dynamic-loop behavior are unverified. Four recorded standalone GLSL330 leaf cases pass in retained receipts, but are not actual driver or native whole-stage evidence.

The retained original AstraLex Mac failure is documented in [original integration evidence](solas-astralex-integration-r1.md), including original-only Fabric26.3 linker SIGSEGV. This source change does not establish a working original or justify weakening that native guard. Parent owns exact final catalog/native-boundary pins, packaging and any later runtime acceptance. CPU review work is released.

## Actual source/default consumer

Original ASCII Astra93 SHA70b6d8127a6733f0a19bd1d351b92709d6ee7496967ff49c4793d2c28c7a6c58. Original world0/deferred.fsh (0ab067522ccaf2aeb3c6bc7d007ff8fa63df4e01bd4486247f5c80dedda65506) declares DEFERRED/FRAGMENT/OVERWORLD and includes actual program/deferred.glsl (846c3fdf2cc66dd02d0f9bd87acf847118ae9f485490351af26d281c556c2ee4). That program contains OffsetDist/DoAmbientOcclusion and main's actual AO call on z<1, with hand earlyreturn z<0.56. settings/globalSettings.glsl (e01d79612ede70f6a5ec5ef400aced64fbdf217d208974e2c98252b97e6298b5) defines AO, QUALITY2/FOVSCALE4/STRENGTH1 AND ADVANCED_MATERIALS. All three are independently member-pinned and covered by original complete shader digest. Settings/sourceAA/history are unmodified.

Depth-only AO sets samples12/scm0.6, iterates symmetric plus/minus sample pairs and adds clamped pair visibility. It forms mean1/samples then runs nonlinear sqrt/strength ONCE afterward. No periteration attenuation/recurrence exists. Actual source graph contains NO DH/Voxy implementation/reference; external DISTANT_HORIZONS/VOXY macro checks are defensive refusal, NOT compatibility proof. No invented RP_* or customPBR macro. Default ADVANCED_MATERIALS stays eligible because AO uses depth independently before the separate material branch. Custom PBR cannot be identified by an absent switch and remains runtime/quality unverified; no support claim is added.

## Exact existing policy and preserved arithmetic

The family adapter includes unchanged uniform_sample_budget SHA00ea6f6ec69da669a9a1727498ba9dd1b40839dce38af42afb26ea8b831d1aec alongside existing refinement helper, using the SAME CORE ABI2/existing REFINE_ADAPTER flag/six existing uniform declarations. Include guards deduplicate them. `shaderlod_astralex_ao_groups(samples/2)` uses min4 groups. Native QUALITY2 is6 two-iteration groups. Balanced ceil(.875*6)=6 →12loops24depth fetches (no reduction); Performance/Aggr ceil(.75*6)=5 →10loops20depth fetches. Source-bound work only, not actual executed counts. Quality1/native4 loops, unsupported pass/FOVquality/bridge/preset/enabled/context remain native; no policy tuning.

Reduced M uses virtual x=float(i)*float(N)/float(M)+dither in the UNCHANGED native OffsetDist(x,N). Native radial endpoint/dither margin x/N=i/M+dither/N, radius0.5/scm/FOV/aspect/depth scale are preserved. M remains even, retaining alternating y populations and original +/- pair balance. Final mean uses1/M only on a genuinely reduced path. Native/no-reduction uses original OffsetDist(i+dither,N) and original mean1/N arithmetic. Pair depth reads/clamps/y flip/strength transforms and the rest of the program stay byte-identical. This is redistributed quadrature, not a native prefix cutoff, radius shrink, half-resolution, temporal or absorption redesign. Source angular/radial sample positions change; noise/contact/edge/thin geometry/derivative behavior and output quality still need real driver/still/motion inspection. Nominal domain preservation does not imply exact per-pixel equality.

Compile eligibility requires explicitly pinned deferred Overworld fragment, AO_QUALITY2 and native declared AO_FOVSCALE1..5, no externally declared DH/Voxy. Unknown/Core invalid returns original group count and exact native expressions. Generated helper may add one real Boolean include-guard option; actual Iris discovery must qualify it before any maintained runtime expectation changes.
